summary.text: Jared Patterson is a Republican state representative from Texas who has represented District 106 since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a business executive who lives in Frisco.

paragraphs.text: Jared Patterson lives in Frisco, Texas, and studied at Texas A&M University.
His career experience includes working as the director of energy services with Rapid Power Management.
Patterson and his wife, Leslie, have two children.
Patterson assumed office in the Texas House on January 8, 2019, succeeding Pat Fallon, a Republican.
In 2023 and 2024 he was assigned to the House Transportation Committee, the Calendars Committee and the Licensing & Administrative Procedures Committee.
